record.body:
## Description

R4: `canon init --schemas score,conductor,tuner,composer` creates a store that `canon validate` accepts. The required suite failed in tests/test_contract_self_consistency.py because test stores omit composer while discovery finds the composer types.

## Approach

In tests/helpers.py set SCHEMAS to `score,conductor,tuner,composer`. In tests/test_contract_self_consistency.py include composer in the expected namespaces and rename the test to match. Run the file; fix any other test that counts namespaces.

payload.title: Fix contract tests for the composer namespace
